title: Mobile Shop Accounts
summary: Money in, money out and vendor payments for a mobile shop.
problem: Daily cash, vendor payments and expenses were in notebooks and spreadsheets.
solution: A simple accounts app with daily entries, vendor balances and monthly summaries.

features.title: Daily entries
features.description: Cash and bank in and out in a few taps.

features.title: Vendor balances
features.description: See who is owed what at any time.

results: Month-end is no longer a guessing game
